high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from Bloomberg's Instagram account, posted 7 hours prior to the capture of the screenshot. The post features a photograph of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) building, which is a prominent symbol of financial markets. The building is adorned with American flags, indicating its location in the United States. The photo captures a scene outside the NYSE, where several individuals are walking past the iconic structure.
